reconstruction: Read ordered part-0000.b64 through part-0117.b64 as exact UTF-8 without linefeeds; strict-base64 decode each separately; concatenate decoded bytes; verify INDEX archive length, SHA256 and Git blob; stream tar.gz through complete CRC and verify every CAS object and logical mapping against the retained manifest. Never follow recorded symlinks.
scope: Complete frozen R1/R2/R3 originals, including all real failures and terminal development groups. Historical source packet pending fields and ordered test IDs are preserved.
temporary_packaging_boundary: Only wheel/install files actually retained by the original tests are included; automatically cleaned TemporaryDirectory products are not recreated or claimed as retained.
